IrodoriTTSSaveAudio.description: Save and preview audio under output/audio. Date templates use the local time at execution.

filename_prefix.name: Filename prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Filename prefix. Replace {yyyymmddhhmmss}, {yyyymmdd}, and {hhmmss} with the date and time.

directory.name: Directory
directory.tooltip: Path relative to output/audio. Leave empty to save directly there. Supports date templates and nested folders.

bitrate.name: Bitrate (kbps)
bitrate.tooltip: MP3 bitrate in kbps. Ignored for WAV and FLAC.

bit_depth.name: Bit depth
bit_depth.tooltip: WAV and FLAC bit depth. Ignored for MP3.

IrodoriTTSGenerate.description: Generate Japanese speech with compatible Irodori-TTS models from models.json. Reference audio transcripts are not required.

seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
seconds.tooltip: Use 0 to predict the duration automatically, or specify a fixed duration in seconds.

precision.name: Precision
precision.tooltip: Precision for non-quantized models. Quantized models always use BF16.

allow_download.name: Allow download
allow_download.tooltip: Download missing model files on the first run.

caption.name: Caption
caption.tooltip: Describe vocal expression and speaking style for text_caption and text_caption_reference modes.

reference_audio.name: Reference audio
reference_audio.tooltip: Connect one or more clips from Load Reference Audios, or one clip from the standard Load Audio node.

unload_after_generate.name: Unload after generation
unload_after_generate.tooltip: Keep the model for reuse when disabled. Release it after generation when enabled.

model_name.name: Model
model_name.tooltip: Choose a model from models.json. Restart ComfyUI after editing the list. Quantized models use CUDA and BF16. Changing the model reloads it.

dynamic_vram.name: Dynamic VRAM
dynamic_vram.tooltip: Offload TTS model weights as needed when ComfyUI Dynamic VRAM is enabled. Otherwise, or on CPU, use standard loading. Codec device is configured separately.

IrodoriTTSLoadReferenceAudios.description: Select one or more files from input/irodori_references. Each clip keeps its sample rate and duration and is passed through the same output.

files.name: Files
files.tooltip: Select files from input/irodori_references. Use the up and down arrows to reorder them. Files are used from top to bottom.
